observations: Single photo shows a black cylindrical speaker standing upright on a table.
'SONOS' text is embossed/printed vertically on the fabric-like perforated surface of the speaker.
A watermark reading 'POSTED ON... ESOJE & CO. ENTERPRISES' overlays the image; this is the seller's own watermark, not a verification mark.
No charging cable, charging base, box, or accessories are visible.
No serial number, model plate, or close-up of ports/buttons is visible.
Speaker is not shown powered on, no screen or LED indicator visible.
Shape is a plain round cylinder; the real Sonos Roam has a distinctive asymmetric triangular-prism form, which this photo does not clearly confirm or deny due to angle/lighting.

identity.model: Roam (seller-claimed, text 'SONOS' visible but 'Roam' model text not legible in photo)

claims.evidence: Brand text 'SONOS' is visible in photo 0, but no model-specific marking, serial number, or packaging is shown to confirm it is a genuine Roam rather than a lookalike or counterfeit.

claims.claim: Can work as a normal portable bluetooth speaker and can work standalone
claims.evidence: No photo or clip shows the device powered on, connected, or producing sound.

risks.risk: Counterfeit or clone device using Sonos branding
risks.proof: Close-up photo of bottom plate showing model/serial number, plus a photo of the official Sonos app recognizing the device
risks.if_unproven: priced as an unbranded/uncertain-authenticity speaker, not as a genuine Sonos Roam

risks.risk: Battery or charging fault (Roam uses a proprietary magnetic charger)
risks.proof: A clip showing the speaker powering on, charging indicator lighting up, and audio playing

risks.risk: Missing charging cable/base, which is required and somewhat proprietary
risks.proof: Photo of included charger/cable alongside the unit
risks.if_unproven: priced as speaker only, no accessories

risks.risk: Physical/water damage not visible from this single front angle
risks.proof: Photos of top, bottom, and underside showing ports and any dents or corrosion
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible hidden cosmetic/water damage

proof_requests: Close-up of the bottom of the speaker showing model number/serial sticker
Photo or short video of the speaker powered on and playing audio
Photo of the charging cable/base included in the sale
Photo of the Sonos app screen showing the device paired and recognized
response.reason: The brand is visible and the item type is clear, but authenticity and working condition are unverified from a single static photo, so it must be priced at worst case as an unconfirmed-authenticity, unproven-working unit with no accessories shown.
